translations.c02: Failure(s) or Malfunction(s): the sudden, unforeseeable event(s) not declared in the TrustReport that result(s) in the total or partial loss of functionality of the Covered Components pursuant to Article 3.3 of these Specific Terms and Conditions, requiring their repair or replacement. This definition does not include defects or faults already reported or declared in the TrustReport, as well as those resulting from normal wear and tear, insufficient or irregular maintenance, improper use, negligence or non-compliance with the manufacturer's instructions, resulting from tampering, unauthorised work or non-compliant alterations, or resulting from accidental or external events such as accidents, collisions, fire, flooding, natural disasters or other force majeure, which shall therefore be excluded from cover under this article. The qualification of the Failure or Malfunction and its eligibility for cover are left to the technical assessment of Fleequid® or the Authorised Centre, in accordance with the procedure set out in Articles 7 and 8 of these Specific Terms and Conditions.
translations.c03: Claim: the written communication sent by the Buyer to Fleequid® via the official channels indicated (claims@fleequid.com or dedicated portal) to report a fault or request work under warranty, as well as any subsequent dispute concerning the handling or outcome of the case. The Claim under these Specific Terms and Conditions is separate from the complaint governed by Article 13 of the General Terms and Conditions, does not replace it and does not interrupt or extend its time limits.
translations.c04: The Fleequid Care® Service is an optional, non-insurance commercial warranty pursuant to Article 1322 of the Italian Civil Code. It does not constitute an insurance product or contract, nor does it involve the assumption of future or indefinite random risks. The economic risk associated with the provision of guarantee services is assumed directly by Fleequid® (Adorea S.r.l.), which acts in its own right and not as an intermediary or agent of insurance companies.
translations.c05: The warranty operates exclusively in favour of the Buyer. The Service is autonomous and separate, in terms of legal basis and content, from the contracts of sale of the Vehicle, however concluded and structured pursuant to the General Terms and Conditions, and does not replace or alter the Seller's legal responsibilities arising from applicable law or the General Terms and Conditions. Fleequid® assumes a direct and independent obligation to the Buyer solely for the services set out in these Specific Terms and Conditions; the obligations arising therefrom remain separate from those arising from the aforementioned contracts of sale and do not alter the rules governing them. The transferability of the Service is governed by Article 4.5 below, referred to herein in full.
translations.c06: The Fleequid Care® Service commences automatically on the date of delivery of the Vehicle to the Buyer, as shown on the sales and transport documents issued by Fleequid®. This date marks the start of the period of validity of the warranty. At the time of delivery, the mileage of the Vehicle is recorded and constitutes the initial mileage for the purposes of Article 4.2 below. The initial mileage is noted in the delivery report, where drawn up, which constitutes primary evidence thereof; failing this, the initial mileage is derived from other documentary or photographic evidence contemporaneous with delivery and verifiable by Fleequid®. For these purposes, the mileage indicated in the Auction data sheet or in the Technical Specifications shall not be taken into account.
translations.c07: The Service is valid until the earlier of the expiry of three (3) months from the date of delivery and the Vehicle having travelled fifteen thousand (15,000) kilometres from the initial mileage recorded pursuant to Article 4.1 above, whichever limit is reached first, without the possibility of tacit renewal or automatic extension. The Service shall terminate automatically upon the first limit being reached, without the need for termination or communication by Fleequid® or the Buyer. A Failure that becomes apparent within both the time limit and the mileage limit shall be covered, provided that it is promptly reported pursuant to Article 7, even if, at the time of the report, the Service has in the meantime terminated owing to one or both limits having been reached.
translations.c08: The Buyer accepts and acknowledges that the division between direct coverage and Fleequid® Voucher is an essential element of the Fleequid Care® Service and that the issue of the Voucher integrates to all intents and purposes the contractual performance of Fleequid®. The issue of the Voucher shall constitute full and final payment of the corresponding portion of the indemnity.
translations.c09: During the validity of the Service, the Buyer undertakes not to alter, tamper with or disable electronic diagnostic systems or on-board data recording devices (OBD, ECU, telematics systems, odometer). Any ascertained alterations, tampering or documental discrepancies shall lead to immediate forfeiture of the warranty. The Buyer shall promptly notify Fleequid® of any failure or replacement of the odometer, indicating the mileage shown at the time of the event. Any failure or replacement not attributable to the Buyer and promptly notified shall not lead to the forfeiture provided for in this paragraph, without prejudice to the Buyer's burden of proving the relevant mileage for the purposes of Article 4.2.
translations.c10: The report of the Failure must contain at least the following elements: identification details of the Buyer and the Vehicle (registration number, chassis/VIN, mileage, date of delivery), a summary description of the anomaly found indicating the date and circumstances of occurrence, photographic or video documentation where available and any other element useful for preliminary assessment, as well as, where possible, documentation attesting to the ordinary maintenance or the most recent repairs carried out. Together with the report, the Buyer shall provide documentary or photographic evidence of the mileage of the Vehicle at the time of occurrence of the Failure.
translations.c11: Replaced components remain the property of Fleequid®, which may freely dispose of them for purposes of technical inspection, reconditioning or disposal. The Authorised Centre, or the Buyer in the case of repairs expressly authorised by Fleequid®, undertakes to keep them for at least thirty (30) days from the closure of the file, unless otherwise instructed.
translations.c12: Failures already evident at the time of delivery of the Vehicle, as well as defects, faults or anomalies already detected, reported, highlighted or declared in the TrustReport or otherwise known to the Buyer or Seller at the time of delivery;
translations.c13: Any coverage for damage occurring after the termination of coverage pursuant to Art. 4.2, even if it relates to Failures or defects that arose at an earlier time but had not yet become apparent at the time of termination of the warranty, is expressly excluded, without prejudice to the provisions of the same Art. 4.2 regarding a Failure that became apparent within the limits indicated therein and was reported subsequently.
translations.c14: If the mediation procedure is not concluded with an amicable agreement within ninety (90) days from its commencement, or if one of the Parties does not participate, any dispute arising out of the interpretation, execution, validity or termination of these Specific Terms and Conditions and, more generally, of the Fleequid Care® Service, shall be settled by arbitration, according to law, by a single arbitrator, appointed in accordance with the Rules of the Chamber of Arbitration of Milan, which the Parties hereby declare to accept in full.
translations.c15: It is understood that the existence of a force majeure does not exempt the Buyer from the obligation to pay the price of the Fleequid Care® Service, nor does it suspend the period of validity of the Service as stipulated in Article 4. Similarly, any delays in repair due to force majeure affecting the Authorised Centre shall not result in an extension of the duration of the Service or in liability for Fleequid®.
translations.c16: Fleequid® shall send all notifications to the addresses, including ordinary e-mail addresses, indicated by the Buyer during registration on the Fleequid® Marketplace or subsequently updated, and such notifications shall be presumed delivered to and read by the recipient after they are sent by Fleequid®. It is the Buyer's responsibility to keep their addresses up to date; any change to the contact addresses must be notified in writing in order to be considered valid.

notes: c02, c11, c15: correzioni di soli refusi IT (determinano, autorizzata, punto finale); EN precedente già corretto, restituito identico.
c03: corretto il doppio punto finale '..' dell'EN precedente prima della frase aggiunta.
c12: 'Guasti' reso con maiuscola 'Failures' (termine definito, come nell'IT), mentre l'EN precedente aveva 'failures' minuscolo.

c07/c13: 'manifestatosi' reso con 'becomes/became apparent', come in 9.4 EN precedente ('had not yet become apparent'); in c10 'manifestazione' resta 'occurrence' per coerenza con la stessa frase dell'EN precedente ('circumstances of occurrence').
c13: 'art.' reso 'Art.' come in 9.3 EN precedente ('(Art. 3.3)').

c05: il testo nuovo sostituisce 'contract of sale concluded between the Buyer and the Seller on the Fleequid® Marketplace' con 'sales contracts for the Vehicle' (plurale e formula delle Generali), perché l'IT copre ora anche la struttura con Rivendita.
review: c05: 'sales contracts' (2 occorrenze) → 'contracts of sale', perché la v1 EN di questo documento usa già 'contract of sale' per 'contratto di compravendita' (priorità 1 sulle T&C Generali).

c07: 'the lapse of three (3) months ... and the reaching of fifteen thousand (15,000) kilometres travelled from' → 'the expiry of three (3) months ... and the Vehicle having travelled fifteen thousand (15,000) kilometres from', perché 'the reaching of' è innaturale e 'expiry' è il termine v1 (4.2) per lo spirare del periodo; significato e grassetti invariati.

c07: 'while both the time limit and the mileage limit are complied with' → 'within both the time limit and the mileage limit', perché 'complied with' riferito a limiti è improprio; 'rispettati' = non superati.
c07: 'reported in a timely manner' → 'promptly reported', perché 'promptly' è la resa v1 di 'tempestivamente' (6.3, 6.6) ed è la stessa usata in c09.
c07: 'owing to one or both limits being reached' → 'owing to one or both limits having been reached', concordanza temporale con 'has in the meantime terminated'.
c14: 'a sole arbitrator' → 'a single arbitrator', perché la v1 EN usa già 'single arbitrator' (priorità 1); rimozione del 'Board of Arbitrators' correttamente recepita.

Verificati senza modifiche: c02, c11, c15 identici all'EN precedente (refusi solo IT); c03 correzione '..' ammessa; c04 e c08 rimozioni recepite; c06, c09, c10, c12, c13, c16 equivalenti all'IT nuova con terminologia coerente (odometer, mileage, forfeiture, delivery report, Technical Specifications, complaint per il reclamo art. 13 CG).
